messages:
carla_csm: Quick flag  a batch of onboarding tenants (14 total) experienced intermittent webhook auth failures and delayed activations between 08:1208:35 UTC on 2026-08-05. I'm marking 2 accounts as renewal-risk for close follow-up. Need a one-paragraph external update, a short validation checklist, and clear credit policy language differentiating Hosted vs Dedicated customers.

ben_cs: Ack. Important: if any Dedicated deployments were self-managed (private) we need to be careful about credit wording. Can SRE confirm which types affected? :eyes: 

omar_sre: ops_bot created incident INC-2026-0805-08 at 1799008800. Quick triage: a cert rotation on our webhook gateway briefly accepted older signing keys; some legacy SDK clients failed validation and retried, causing partial write delays. Most hits were on hosted onboarding pipelines; a few private Dedicated tenants using the SDK with older client cert bundles also saw failures.

liam_infra: Telemetry: webhook_auth_fail_rate spiked to 7.4% (baseline ~0.1%) during the window. After we pushed a permissive fallback and notified SDK owners at 1799010000, fail_rate dropped to 0.4%. Replays started at 1799010060; progress ~68% now.

omar_sre: Actions taken: added an expedited compatibility fallback for pre-rotation signatures, rolled forward a safer rotation process, and queued idempotent replays. Also created a short-term alert for auth_fail_rate > 1% at 1799010120.

carla_csm: Draft external update (concise): ```Hello  between 08:1208:35 UTC on 2026-08-05 we saw intermittent webhook authentication failures that delayed some onboarding activations. Cause: an authentication key rotation on our gateway that briefly rejected older client signatures; some SDK clients retried and caused delayed writes for a subset of tenants. What we did: deployed a compatibility fallback, reprocessed affected batches, and are monitoring progress. Current status: replays ~68% complete; most tenants are processing normally. Next steps: final replay expected within 4 hours; office hours at 16:00 UTC today to review impact and answer questions (link). Compensation: Hosted customers impacted will receive a pro-rated onboarding credit; for Dedicated (customer-managed) deployments we will coordinate individually and may offer targeted assistance rather than automatic credits. CS will reach out to eligible accounts directly. Apologies for the disruption.  Redwood Inference Team```

ben_cs: Good. Suggest adding a tiny validation checklist customers can run and a curl snippet for webhook users: (1) check recent index doc counts, (2) resend a small test webhook and confirm 200, (3) verify last_indexed_at for a sample doc. Snippet: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Signature: <sig>" -d '{"text":"smoke"}' https://webhook.redwood.example/v1/ingest -i```

liam_infra: Postmortem note for CS: root cause = rotation process accepted new keys before a compatibility window was fully active + some clients lacked updated bundles; fix = safer rotation sequence + compatibility fallback + improved SDK update telemetry. Full postmortem ETA EOD 2026-08-05.

omar_sre: SRE confirmation: fallback deployed at 1799010000, replay jobs started 1799010060, current replay progress 68%. No new auth spikes after 1799010100.

carla_csm: Final ask: Ben please send the external note to affected tenants and CC me. I'll own renewal-risk outreach for the two flagged accounts and will confirm credit eligibility. Also please include this short paragraph for Dedicated customers: "If you run a Dedicated or Private deployment, we will coordinate a bespoke remediation and support window with you; credits are evaluated on a case-by-case basis for self-managed environments."

ben_cs: Sending now. I'll include the checklist and Dedicated wording and post an internal-only followup with the exact account list. Office hours link included.

omar_sre: Monitoring replay backlog; will notify CS if any tenant replays fall behind >6h.

liam_infra: Adding rotation logs and a short snippet of the compatibility patch to the postmortem draft for CS reference.

ops_bot: [update] INC-2026-0805-08 | mitigation=compatibility_fallback,rotation_sequence_fix | replay_progress=68% | status=monitoring

carla_csm: Thanks team  closing loop for CS prep. Please DM if any replays exceed 6 hours so I can escalate credits/assistance."
